Dear Emma,

Congratulations! Your trips to Paris and London have been successfully booked. Here's a summary of all your reservations:

=== PARIS TRIP (February 20-25, 2026) ===

🏨 HOTEL: Luxury Palace
   Address: 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France
   Price: €500-1000 per night
   Rating: 5.0/5.0
   Check-in: February 20, 2026
   Check-out: February 25, 2026

🍽️ RESTAURANT: Le Baratin
   Address: 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France
   Cuisine: French (homestyle cooking)
   Price: €30 per person
   Rating: 4.8/5.0
   Reservation: February 21, 2026 at 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM
   Note: Cash only, gluten-free options available

🚗 CAR RENTAL: Paris Rent-a-Car
   Address: 23 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   Price: €45 per day
   Rating: 4.5/5.0
   Vehicles: Sedan, SUV, Convertible
   Fuel: Regular, Premium, Electric
   Rental Period: February 20, 2026 9:00 AM - February 25, 2026 9:00 AM

=== LONDON TRIP (February 25 - March 1, 2026) ===

🏨 HOTEL: London Luxury
   Address: 10 Park Lane, London W1K 1LB, United Kingdom
   Price: £80-150 per night
   Rating: 5.0/5.0
   Check-in: February 25, 2026
   Check-out: March 1, 2026

🍽️ RESTAURANT: House of Sushi
   Address: 456 Regent Street, London, UK
   Cuisine: Italian (pasta and pizza)
   Price: £40 per person
   Rating: 4.5/5.0
   Reservation: February 26, 2026 at 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM
   Note: Vegetarian and gluten-free options available

🚗 CAR RENTAL: New Car Rental
   Address: 123 Oxford Street, London W1D 2HG, United Kingdom
   Price: £50 per day
   Rating: 4.5/5.0
   Vehicles: Sedan, SUV, Convertible
   Fuel: Regular, Premium
   Rental Period: February 25, 2026 9:00 AM - March 1, 2026 9:00 AM

=== ADDITIONAL RECOMMENDATIONS ===

Paris Restaurants to Consider:
- New Asiaway (Chinese, 4.6 rating, €30) - Great modern Chinese cuisine
- Bistrot Paul Bert (French, 4.5 rating, €40) - Classic Parisian bistro
- Miznon (Israeli, 4.3 rating, €15) - Casual street food

London Restaurants to Consider:
- Home Kitchen (Asian Fusion, 4.3 rating, £35) - Innovative fusion dishes
- Azabu Ramen (British, 4.2 rating, £30) - Traditional British with modern twist

Alternative Hotels:
- Paris: Montmartre Suites (4.7 rating, €110-200) - Great value with Montmartre views
- London: Riverside View (4.6 rating, £200-350) - Stunning Thames views

=== IMPORTANT NOTES ===
- All reservations are confirmed and will appear in your calendar
- Please bring your passport (HGK137803) for hotel check-ins
- For Le Baratin, remember it's cash only
- Car rentals include insurance - please review terms at pickup

Have a wonderful trip! If you need any changes or additional bookings, please let me know.

Best regards,
Your Travel Assistant
